notes.title: Free DLC New Taste – In Development
notes.content:
What awaits you in the DLC New Taste?  
The DLC is made in the Quest genre where you will be able to:
Travel through 5 locations of KD Corp

Paint 16 new pictures

Unravel the recipe mystery of the new chips flavor

Communicate with and help 3 new characters

Encounter and discover special events  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45336884/9da742a47de95c16ebaf5d8bce364e1fcfa33c8f.gif"]
The main game will also be improved:
Special tasks from regular jobs will gain not only cosmetic but also practical meaning

Lighting in several locations has been reworked

The environment and job selection have been refined

Dialogue voice effects inspired by Undertale will be added

Improvements for controller play and Steam Deck support  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45336884/cdbe6f00d2018cf7b7f3d448517211a45d002ccc.gif"]

The list may and most likely will grow, but one thing is clear: this DLC will be big and will significantly improve the game and your experience!!!  

This is a free DLC that will be released as a patch.  
All game owners will receive it automatically.
Follow the progress
  
Subscribe to our Twitter account where updates on the DLC are published every week.  

Thank you <3
  
I am grateful to you for playing, liking, writing reviews, and sharing my game.  

Only thanks to your support did I dare to make this DLC, and because of you, it has already become better than before.  

P.S. With love, Kirillov Dmitrii by Kirillov Production

notes.title: New menu, new music and a small piece of new DLC
notes.content:
Long time no see, we missed you <3


We're working on a new game, and also continuing development on the free DLC for Sanechek: Lost Coins

The new DLC will tell us about how Sanechek works at "KD Chips". The release date isn't fully decided yet, but we're aiming to release it by the end of the year.

As for the patch, we’ve redesigned the home menu — exploring and breathing in the room has become much more exciting as part of the DLC preparation.

Follow us on social networks and stay updated, thank you for being there

notes.title: Sanechek: lost coins is out NOW! ٩(◕‿◕｡)۶
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45336884/79be874313eeb0051e306f473da0c2a2442ea92b.png
⋆𐙚₊˚⊹♡
After six months, Sanechek is here! Woo-hoo!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346950

Finally, you can help earn some coins for chips for this kitty-girl!

Tips about what you can do in Sanechek:
- first off, work five different jobs (how else did you think you'd earn coins for chipusu?)
- second, follow the storyline! Sanechek’s life will surprise you
- also, don’t forget to draw! Sanechek absolutely loves it
- and most importantly: enjoy!

Thank you to everyone who added it to their wishlists — may you always have chips at home <3

okey-dokey, I’m off to earn more coins, see ya! 
Sanechek
